name: Npc Spellclick Spells
description: Spells cast when a player clicks a creature with UNIT_NPC_FLAG_SPELLCLICK. Cast Flags decide who casts on whom; availability is gated either by Condition Id or (legacy) by the quest columns. Backport of the WoTLK spellclick system.

fields.name: Npc Entry
fields.help: Creature entry (creature_template) that is clicked, must have UNIT_NPC_FLAG_SPELLCLICK.

fields.name: Spell Id
fields.help: Spell cast on click. Can be 0 for special cases handled by script (OnNpcSpellClick).

fields.name: Quest Start
fields.help: Legacy requirement (ignored when Condition Id is set): quest that must be rewarded (or active, see Quest Start Active) for the spellclick to work, 0 = no quest requirement.

fields.name: Quest Start Active
fields.help: If 1, having Quest Start merely active (taken) is enough; if 0, it must be rewarded.

fields.name: Quest End
fields.help: Legacy requirement (ignored when Condition Id is set): spellclick stops working once this quest is rewarded, 0 = never expires.

fields.name: Cast Flags
fields.help: Bit 1: the clicking player is the caster (otherwise the clicked creature). Bit 2: the clicking player is the target (otherwise the clicked creature).

fields.name: Condition Id
fields.help: conditions.condition_entry controlling whether the spellclick is available to a given player. When set, the quest columns are ignored. 0 = use quest columns.

fields.name: Condition
fields.help: Edit the condition tree referenced by Condition Id.
